description: Track active buy and sell orders by unique order ID, type, and price. Orders can be added, repriced, canceled, or queried by type and price; the query returns matching active IDs in any order. Example 1: orders 4 and 5 at (buy, 10) are both returned; changing order 4 to price 11 leaves only order 5 in the first query. Example 2: canceling the only order at a key makes that key return an empty list. Constraints: order IDs are globally unique, and modify/cancel target an active order.
intuition: Updates need a direct route from order ID to its current bucket, while queries need direct access to a type-and-price bucket.

brute_force.approach: Store all orders by ID and scan active orders for each query.

optimal.approach: Maintain an ID-to-order map and a reverse map from (type, price) to a set of IDs.

edge_cases: Changing a price removes the ID from its former bucket before inserting it into the new one.
An empty bucket is removed after cancellation or repricing.
